blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The United States will increase funding for the modernization of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), following talks between US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. in Cebu on Wednesday.
